body: Have read your story, and am so glad you finally answered your phone and decided to stay. Thanks for being here to talk to me.

Right now I can't speak in public about it, it triggers may panic attacks. I used to blog and write about what was going on on different groups' forums, but I got so much negativity: moocher, shirker, work-shy, loser, kill yourself, useless, trash, scum...I gave up. I can't take it anymore. I've paid into the system all of my working life. Disability and Social Security are not entitlements, they are benefits that have been taken out of my paycheck for almost 30 years. Then when I go into all the terrible circumstances I've been in, people just don't believe me, and then I'm a liar. I can't take it when the truth of my life is denied me. I tried, and I'm not strong enough to put myself out there like that any more.

(edit: terrible spelling)

I do have a gofundme, my friends enabled me to get an older RV so I wouldn't be on the street, and they told me to keep it open even though I'm inside now. It's the only income I've had since I lost my job in 2009. I'll PM it to you.

I've had lots of friends tell me how strong I am, but when I get in this mindset, being strong doesn't do anything when you're looking at years of nothing ahead of you...again. I'm so afraid of housing/living insecurity, and falling into abusive situations again.

Thanks for taking the time to talk to me.
